subject: ext-ft
title: EXT.FT.------C.CONT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 124 (ALT(FT)II-18). EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is the subject; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: TECH-DY (technological dynamics), LK-IMP (linkage implications) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From TECH-DY: METH. From LK-IMP: WO-UNF (world unification). From PROG-CONT: INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From METH: PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) and PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental). From WO-UNF: MT-INFO (multi-information) and POL-OR (political order). From INFO-SOLD: SG (source initiation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From PER-VT-U-FUND: AFI (affinity insight).
